camel_example: aliyun cms ModifyGroupMonitoringAgentProcess --region cn-hangzhou --AlertConfig.1.ComparisonOperator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --AlertConfig.1.TargetList.1.Level 'INFO_,_WARN_,_CRITICAL' --AlertConfig.1.EscalationsLevel warn --AlertConfig.1.EffectiveInterval '00:00-22:59' --AlertConfig.1.Threshold 5 --AlertConfig.1.NoEffectiveInterval '00:00-05:30_Deprecated:_true' --AlertConfig.1.Webhook 'http://www.aliyun.com' --GroupId 67800000 --MatchExpressFilterRelation 'and_Deprecated:_true' --AlertConfig.1.TargetList.1.Arn 'acs:mns:cn-hangzhou:1208863178610000:/queues/test/message' --AlertConfig.1.SilenceTime 86400 --AlertConfig.1.Statistics Average --AlertConfig.1.TargetList.1.JsonParams 'customField1_:_value1_,_customField2_:_.name' --AlertConfig.1.Times 3 --Id '92E3065F-0980-4E31-9AA0-BA60000' --AlertConfig.1.TargetList.1.Id 1 --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies process monitoring in an application group
description_zh: 修改应用分组内的进程监控
name: ModifyGroupMonitoringAgentProcess

parameters.help_en: The ID of the process monitoring task in the application group
parameters.help_zh: 应用分组内的进程监控任务ID
parameters.name: id

element_fields.help_en:
The mute period. Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

Unit: seconds. Minimum value: 3600 seconds (1 hour). Default value: 86400 seconds (1 day).
>If the monitoring data continuously exceeds the alert rule threshold, only one alert notification is sent within each mute period
element_fields.help_zh:
通道沉默周期。N的取值范围：1~200。

单位：秒。最小值：3600秒（1小时），默认值：86400秒（1天）。
>当监控数据持续超过报警规则阈值时，每个沉默周期内只发送一次报警通知
element_fields.name: silence_time

element_fields.help_en:
The comparison operator for the Critical level threshold. Valid values of N: 1 to 200. Valid values:

- GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold: greater than or equal to.
- GreaterThanThreshold: greater than.
- LessThanOrEqualToThreshold: less than or equal to.
- LessThanThreshold: less than.
- NotEqualToThreshold: not equal to.
- GreaterThanYesterday: greater than the value at the same time yesterday.
- LessThanYesterday: less than the value at the same time yesterday.
- GreaterThanLastWeek: greater than the value at the same time last week.
- LessThanLastWeek: less than the value at the same time last week.
- GreaterThanLastPeriod: greater than the value in the last period.
- LessThanLastPeriod: less than the value in the last period
element_fields.help_zh:
Critical级别阈值比较符。N的取值范围：1~200。取值：

- GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold：大于等于。
- GreaterThanThreshold：大于。
- LessThanOrEqualToThreshold：小于等于。
- LessThanThreshold：小于。
- NotEqualToThreshold：不等。
- GreaterThanYesterday：同比昨天时间上涨。
- LessThanYesterday：同比昨天时间下降。
- GreaterThanLastWeek：同比上周同一时间上涨。
- LessThanLastWeek：同比上周同一时间下降。
- GreaterThanLastPeriod：环比上周期上涨。
- LessThanLastPeriod：环比上周期下降
element_fields.name: comparison_operator

element_fields.help_en: The callback URL to which a POST request is sent when an alert is triggered. Valid values of N: 1 to 200
element_fields.help_zh: 报警发生时回调指定的URL地址，向URL发送POST请求。N的取值范围：1~200
element_fields.name: webhook

element_fields.help_en:
The number of consecutive occurrences of the alert level. Valid values of N: 1 to 200. Default value: 3.

>An alert is triggered only when the alert level consecutively occurs the specified number of times and the alert threshold is reached
element_fields.help_zh:
报警级别连续出现次数。N的取值范围：1~200。默认值：3。

>只有当报警级别连续出现设定的次数且达到报警阈值时，才会触发报警
element_fields.name: times

element_fields.help_en:
The alert level. Valid values of N: 1 to 200. Valid values:
- critical (default): critical.
- warn: warning.
- info: information
element_fields.help_zh:
报警的级别。N的取值范围：1~200。取值：
- critical（默认值）：故障。
- warn：警告。
- info：信息
element_fields.name: escalations_level

element_fields.help_en: The effective period of the alert rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 200
element_fields.help_zh: 报警规则的生效时间段。N的取值范围：1~200
element_fields.name: effective_interval

element_fields.help_en: The alert threshold. Valid values of N: 1 to 200
element_fields.name: threshold

element_fields.help_en:
The statistical method for alerts. Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

>Currently, only Average is supported
element_fields.help_zh:
报警统计方式。N的取值范围：1~200。

>目前仅支持Average
element_fields.name: statistics

element_fields.help_en:
The ID of the alert trigger target.

For information about how to obtain the alert trigger target ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121592.html
element_fields.help_zh:
报警触发目标ID。

关于如何获取报警触发目标ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121592.html
element_fields.name: id

element_fields.help_en:
The resource ARN.

For information about how to obtain the resource ARN, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121592.html.

The resource ARN is in the format of `acs:{cloud_service_abbreviation}:{regionId}:{userId}:/{resource_type}/{resource_name}/message`. Example: `acs:mns:cn-hangzhou:120886317861****:/queues/test123/message`. The parameters are described as follows:

- {cloud_service_abbreviation}: Currently, only Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) is supported.

- {userId}: The Alibaba Cloud account ID.

- {regionId}: The region where Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) or the topic resides.

- {resource_type}: The type of the resource that accepts alerts. Valid values:

  - **queues**: queue.
  - **topics**: topic.

- {resource_name}: The resource name.

  - If the resource type is **queues**, the resource name is the queue name.
  - If the resource type is **topics**, the resource name is the topic name
element_fields.help_zh:
资源ARN。

关于如何获取资源ARN，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121592.html。

资源ARN的格式为`acs:{云产品缩写}:{regionId}:{userId}:/{资源类型}/{资源名称}/message`。例如：`acs:mns:cn-hangzhou:120886317861****:/queues/test123/message`。参数说明如下：

- {云产品缩写}：目前仅支持轻量消息队列（原 MNS）。

- {userId}：阿里云账号ID。

- {regionId}：轻量消息队列（原 MNS）或主题所在地域。

- {资源类型}：接收报警的资源类型。取值：

  - **queues**：队列。
  - **topics**：主题。

- {资源名称}：资源名称。

  - 如果资源类型为**queues**，则资源名称为队列名称。
  - 如果资源类型为**topics**，则资源名称为主题名称
element_fields.name: arn

element_fields.help_en:
The alert level. Valid values:

- INFO: information.
- WARN: warning.
- CRITICAL: critical
element_fields.help_zh:
报警级别。取值：

- INFO：信息。
- WARN：警告。
- CRITICAL：紧急
element_fields.name: level

element_fields.help_en: The JSON-formatted parameters for the alert callback
element_fields.name: json_params
